On Mon, Jul 18, 2022 at 11:00 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Josh,
I wanted to share something we need your help with.
We have a local partner based in Poland ("Rabochy Ruh") who works in Belarus and cannot activate their
YouTube Ads account.
For background, independent trade unions play a critical role in the movement to restore democratic rights and
freedoms in Belarus, but the current regime makes it nearly impossible for workers to openly express their views.
"Rabochy Ruh" (Workers' Movement) was launched in September 2020 to support workers inside Belarus who
are looking to organize themselves into independent trade unions. Engaging with and attracting new members to
these independent trade unions requires open communication channels that can speak to the needs and
interests of the working class. "Rabochy Ruh" is now working to build its presence on YouTube as a means of
communicating with its broad community of supporters, and has received advisory support already from USAID
to do so. Since "Rabochy Ruh" began producing new content on their YouTube channel in early May, their seven
videos had an average of 53,000 views.
"Rabochy Ruh" is attempting to activate their YouTube Ads account and use paid promotion for their videos.
